title: Compact Attention: Exploiting Structured Spatio-Temporal Sparsity for Fast Video Generation
abstract: The computational demands of self-attention mechanisms pose a critical challenge for transformer-based video generation, particularly in synthesizing ultra-long sequences. Current approaches, such as factorized attention and fixed sparse patterns, fail to fully exploit the inherent spatio-temporal redundancies in video data. Through systematic analysis of video diffusion transformers (DiT), we uncover a key insight: Attention matrices exhibit structured, yet heterogeneous sparsity patterns, where specialized heads dynamically attend to distinct spatiotemporal regions (e.g., local pattern, cross-shaped pattern, or global pattern). Existing sparse attention methods either impose rigid constraints or introduce significant overhead, limiting their effectiveness. To address this, we propose Compact Attention, a hardware-aware acceleration framework featuring three innovations: 1) Adaptive tiling strategies that approximate diverse spatial interaction patterns via dynamic tile grouping, 2) Temporally varying windows that adjust sparsity levels based on frame proximity, and 3) An automated configuration search algorithm that optimizes sparse patterns while preserving critical attention pathways. Our method achieves 1.6∼2.5×acceleration in attention computation on single-GPU setups while maintaining comparable visual quality with full-attention baselines. This work provides a principled approach to unlocking efficient long-form video generation through structured sparsity exploitation.

innovative_points.name: Structured Sparsity Discovery in Video DiT
innovative_points.description: First systematic analysis revealing heterogeneous sparsity patterns in video diffusion transformers
innovative_points.technical_details: Identified 5 dominant patterns: local, cross-shaped, global, time-variant, time-invariant through per-query-token analysis
innovative_points.runtime_impact: Enabled [N, N, d] → [N, N×s, d] where s = 0.3764-0.6601 sparsity ratio
innovative_points.novelty: Pattern stability across prompts/seeds enables offline optimization

innovative_points.name: Tile-Based Deformable Sparse Patterns
innovative_points.description: Hierarchical grouping mechanism respecting video's dual spatio-temporal nature
innovative_points.technical_details: Frame-group-wise patterns + dual attention windows for cross-shaped and local pattern approximation
innovative_points.runtime_impact: [N, N×s, d] with 3D spatial grouping improving sparsity by 1-3.4% over direct flattening
innovative_points.novelty: Eliminates need for explicit pattern classification during inference

innovative_points.name: Offline Auto-Search Algorithm
innovative_points.description: Training-free optimization through boundary contraction with dual threshold control
innovative_points.technical_details: τ (recall threshold) + λ (cost threshold) with conservative cross-prompt merging
innovative_points.runtime_impact: Zero runtime overhead, [N, N×s, d] computed offline via union operations
innovative_points.novelty: Decouples pattern discovery from runtime execution

innovative_points.name: Hardware-Aware Tile Processing
innovative_points.description: ThunderKittens + FlashAttention-2 integration optimized for single-GPU setups
innovative_points.technical_details: Block-wise processing maintains computational regularity while exploiting sparsity
innovative_points.runtime_impact: Memory efficient [block_size, block_size, d] processing vs token-level overhead
innovative_points.novelty: Co-design of sparse operators with hardware constraints

innovative_points.name: Temporal Reuse Mechanism
innovative_points.description: Mask reuse across n consecutive denoising steps leveraging temporal stability
innovative_points.technical_details: Configuration caching reduces search frequency by n× based on diffusion trajectory stability
innovative_points.runtime_impact: [N, N×s, d] computed once per n steps instead of every step
innovative_points.novelty: Exploits temporal robustness of diffusion models

improvements_made.name: Adaptive Threshold Scheduling
improvements_made.description: Dynamic τ(t) and λ(t) based on denoising timestep and noise level
improvements_made.runtime_improvement: [N, N×s(t), d] where s(t) varies from 0.25 to 0.45 across timesteps
improvements_made.quality_impact: Maintains PSNR while achieving additional 10-15% speedup

improvements_made.name: Content-Adaptive Pattern Detection
improvements_made.description: Lightweight CNN complexity classifier for dynamic sparsity adjustment
improvements_made.runtime_improvement: [N, N×s(c), d] where s(c) ∈ [0.3, 0.7] based on content complexity

improvements_made.name: Multi-GPU Distributed Sparsity
improvements_made.description: Spatial/temporal partitioning across GPUs with efficient communication
improvements_made.technical_implementation: Ring-reduce communication for attention weights, spatial frame splitting
improvements_made.runtime_improvement: [N/k, N/k, d] + O(N²/k) communication for k GPUs

improvements_made.name: Learned Pattern Primitives
improvements_made.description: Neural network learning optimal patterns beyond hand-crafted ones
improvements_made.technical_implementation: Small transformer (d_model=128, 2 layers) generating custom masks
improvements_made.runtime_improvement: [N, N×s_learned, d] where s_learned adapts to specific content
improvements_made.quality_impact: 20-30% better sparsity-quality trade-off with lightweight fine-tuning

improvements_made.name: Hierarchical Temporal Grouping
improvements_made.description: Motion-aware frame grouping using optical flow analysis
improvements_made.technical_implementation: RAFT optical flow + scene transition detection for adaptive grouping

concise_paper.title: Compact Attention: Exploiting Structured Spatio-Temporal Sparsity for Fast Video Generation
concise_paper.problem: Quadratic complexity of self-attention in video diffusion transformers limits ultra-long sequence generation
concise_paper.insight: Attention matrices exhibit stable, heterogeneous sparsity patterns across specialized heads
concise_paper.method: Training-free framework with adaptive tiling, temporal windows, and offline auto-search
concise_paper.results: 2.5× speedup on Hunyuan, 1.65× on Wan2.1 with maintained quality
innovations: Structured sparsity discovery enabling offline optimization
Tile-based deformable patterns for hardware efficiency
Temporal reuse mechanism across denoising steps
concise_paper.limitations: Static thresholds, single-GPU focus, content-agnostic patterns
concise_paper.future_work: Adaptive scheduling, content-aware detection, multi-GPU scaling
